<!-- pr-reviewer: c1c610e9929abaff1dabccf001738b196d312228 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- No behaviour change, checked by diffing the old `fixtures_section` in `pages.rs` against the new `fixtures_page.rs`. The same commands are queued with the same arguments: `ImportFixtureDialog`, `BuiltinViseDialog(setup)`, `AccessoryDialog(setup)`, `FixturePlateDialog(setup)` and `TagFixture{name, setup}`. The Mark button keeps its "exactly one selected model" condition. The draft retirement, the fixture rows (`fixture_rows::row`, untouched) and the machine-table line are all kept. Nothing writes a field directly.
- The `labelled_by` calls in `fixture_plate_rows.rs` / `fixture_plate_dialog.rs` are untouched. The only edit near them is `unnamed_inputs` becoming `pub(super)` so the new pin can reuse it.
- Layering holds: ui only, using the existing `fixture`/`model`/`units` app API. The `flecs_ecs` `Entity` type in a signature is already used elsewhere in ui, e.g. `actions.rs`.
- No PNG or snapshot is changed. The new file is 111 lines and the new test file 202, both with a provenance line. `pages.rs` shrinks by 77 lines (it was already far over 400). No process files are touched. The decision file is present.

**Local results (merged with upstream main; the branch already contained it, trial merge clean)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=1` (CWD crates/ui) | 680 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Mutation: Accessory button queues the vise dialog | `the_fixtures_page_adds_open_their_dialogs` goes red |
| Mutation: Mark never offered | `the_fixtures_page_offers_mark_for_exactly_one_selected_model` goes red |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The `labelled_by` gap the author names is real but small. The dowel fields (`fixture_plate_rows.rs:97-98`) only draw when `draft.dowels` is true, and the new pin never switches that on, so stripping only those two calls would stay green. They still carry `labelled_by(l.id)` in this PR, so nothing is lost today. Adding a "Dowel pair" click to the pin would close it; a follow-up is enough.
- Overlap with #1438 on the Import button is as described in the PR body; whoever merges second ports one call into `fixtures_page.rs`.
- The PR body ends `Refs #1440` (slice, so correct) and has a `Changelog:` line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c1c610e9929abaff1dabccf001738b196d312228 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (screenshots still owed, see notes).

**What looks good**
- Layout only holds. I compared the moved code with the old `fixtures_section` in `pages.rs`: the draft retirement, state lines, machine-table line, fixture row call (`fixture_rows::row`) and the four dialog/`TagFixture` command pushes are unchanged. The "Mark X as fixture" condition (exactly one selected model) is the same. No control was lost, renamed or newly enabled/disabled. Fixtures are not given any parameter here, so no default, unit or clamp can have moved.
- ui layering is kept: no new world-level calls in ui; the page only reads through `camcraft_app::fixture`/`model` as before and queues commands.
- New `fixtures_page.rs` is 111 lines, `pages.rs` shrinks by 75, new tests file is 202 lines; provenance line present. No snapshot PNG changed. UI text unchanged and plain English. Decisions file `docs/decisions/1440-fixtures-page-tidy.md` present. `Changelog:` line present; `Refs #1440` (does not close the umbrella). No process files touched.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43475768655, main at 7c21c9c)
- Run conclusion: success. Quick gate: ui suites ok, 0 failed (72 s). Clippy `-p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings`: green. Merged tree, no conflict.
- Linux only; the diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS values.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. The body says "Screenshots: before/after attached below", but none are attached. The maintainer wants before/after screenshots on UI PRs (with and without fixtures); owed before `/merge-ready` offers it.
2. Overlap with #1469 (lathe chucks): it touches only app/sim/accessory files and a decisions file, nothing under `crates/ui`, so the two do not conflict textually; either may merge first. The overlap the author names is #1438 (the Import button in `fixtures_section`), which will need its one call ported into `fixtures_page.rs` by whichever merges second.
3. Not exercised: clicking "Import fixture..." (native dialog) and a real narrow window by hand.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
